desc: A large ancient IRON KEY with a ring-shaped bow and a heavy toothed bit, dark and rust-flecked, standing upright, leaning against a small stone. an ancient sacred relic of the first ten humans, small, weathered and very old, seen from the high three-quarter top-down game camera, standing upright on its own (no stand, no table, no ground) as it would sit on a small offering tray.
